mentions.name: Mu
mentions.description: An all-in-one app that combines blog, news, chat, video, mail and web as little micro apps for daily habits, deliberately built without ads, algorithms or exploits.
mentions.problem: Everyday apps are laden with ads, algorithms and exploits.
mentions.source_excerpt:
For about a year I've been working on Mu - an app for everything without ads, algorithms or exploits. https://mu.xyz

Blog, news, chat, video, mail, web. Basically all the daily habits as little micro apps in one thing. I find it quite useful.

mentions.description: A personal app platform without ads, now featuring a mini apps builder powered by LLMs and a voice agent for hands-free navigation of the platform, such as while in the car.
mentions.problem: Personal apps are typically cluttered with ads; this platform is ad-free.
mentions.audience: Explicitly framed as a personal app platform, used hands-free by the builder in the car.

mentions.name: Mu
mentions.description: Mu is a personal app platform combining chat with AI, news, video, posts, and mail in one place. It is built as a non-addictive alternative to ad-driven, algorithmic, tracking-heavy technology, aiming to restore utility value with the author as the first user.
mentions.problem: Tech is too addictive now, driven by ads, algorithms, and tracking; the goal is to get back to utility value.
mentions.source_excerpt: Mu - a personal app platform that includes chat with AI, news, video, posts and now mail. Solving a personal problem with ads, algorithms, tracking.

evidence.value: Mu - a personal app platform that includes chat with AI, news, video, posts and now mail. Solving a personal problem with ads, algorithms, tracking.

mentions.description: A minimal personal app for the author's daily activities, including LLM chat and news headlines, built out of frustration with the state of the internet.
mentions.problem: The author can't stand the state of the internet and needs a really basic app for the specific things they do on a daily basis.
